section.6: The Book of the Times (of Prayer)

6.name_native: The Book of the Times (of Prayer)

hadiths.text: It was narrated that An-Nu'man bin Bashir said:"By Allah, I am the most knowledgeable of people about the time of the 'Isha' prayers. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray it when the moon set on the third night of the month
